commit_message:
Design plan-review: section-aware dedup, revise.env allowlist cleanup, streak tests (#3143)

Make post-apply duplicate-line removal skip consecutive identical lines inside Constraints headings (including nested subheadings) while still collapsing duplicates elsewhere and inside fenced code. Drop revise.env from the round revise publish allowlist across lib-design-round-artifacts, SECURITY.md, and integration fixtures. Document loop-vs-Gate-B dedup divergence and that legacy single-pass mode is harness-only. Add four plan-review-loop harness cases for streak convergence, important-finding streak reset, dedicated degraded-round streak reset, and section-aware dedup.
